title: CDK4/6 inhibition overcomes venetoclax resistance mechanisms with enhanced combination activity in acute myeloid leukemia
model: OCI-AML2 AML cells, genome-wide knockout (5 guides/gene)
contrast: Palbociclib vs DMSO (2 vs 2); venetoclax and combination arms also run
paper_method: Guide-level edgeR-style tests, gene tiers by guide FDR
paper_calls: Ven: BAX, PMAIP1; palbo: RB1, HNRNPU, CEBPE; combo: IKZF1
barcs_calls: Palbo: 1,350 genes at FDR 0.10; ven/combo: depletion uninterpretable (collapsed libraries)
named_hits: Palbo arm: CEBPE #3, HNRNPU #16, IKZF1 #109, RB1 FDR 0.09; BAX and IKZF1 missed in ven/combo
verdict: The palbociclib arm reproduces the paper's top resistance genes. In the venetoclax and combination arms the library collapsed onto a few resistant clones, and BARCS's Wald test fails at that extreme: BAX rises ~400-fold in both replicates yet gets p = 0.76.
